reasons: The finding is a 'missing' rule: no insurance clause appears anywhere in the document, and the vendor is a hosting/ad-tech provider that collects and stores visitor data, which the rule treats as walk-away territory absent coverage.

The inserted Section 14(j) tracks the playbook model language closely (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M where Customer data is processed, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request) and is appended cleanly to the General Provisions without altering existing text in p0073.
The comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, explains the gap and offers the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) as a landing zone.
Deterministic checks pass; the insertion is the minimal edit needed to reach the playbook position.
